pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: inference-gateway > 5xx error-rate spike in region-usw2 (5m avg 9.8%). Alert ID PD-48291. Auto-escalation chain started. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-48291

Alex (oncall): acked. I'm the current oncall, starting triage. Any obvious recent deploys?

Priya (eng-sre): saw a small config push to edge-proxy 18m ago but nothing major. Quick metric: upstream auth-proxy latency jumped 3x ~17:30 UTC. Could be a timeout cascade producing 502s.

Alex (oncall): ok pulling logs from gateway now. Running `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/edge-proxy --since=20m | grep 502 | wc -l` to estimate scope.

Priya (eng-sre): getting the same. sample log: `2026-03-17T17:31:09Z edge-proxy error upstream timeout auth-proxy/usw2-2 504` — multiple pods. Also KV-cache eviction spikes around the same time.

Alex (oncall): starting mitigation: 1) disable optional traffic to auth-proxy (feature flag fallback) 2) add temporary routing to second auth cluster (usw2-b) 3) scale edge-proxy + auth-proxy + kvcache by +30%

Priya (eng-sre): rolled flag fallback (command: `rbacctl set-feature auth_v2 optional --env prod-usw2`). Confirmed requests now take code path that bypasses auth_v2 for non-sensitive endpoints.

pagerbot: PD update: alert PD-48291 acknowledged by Alex at 7305012350.

Alex (oncall): scaled deployments: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/auth-proxy --replicas=12` and scaled edge-proxy to 6. Triggered route swap to auth-proxy-usw2-b via routing service (reroute-id r-7f2).

Priya (eng-sre): kvcache team added node pool for cache warmup. Evictions dropped after warmup started. Telemetry: 5xx rate down to ~4.1% 3m after actions. Latency still ~p95 +120ms.

CS Ops: any customer-facing impact? Customers reporting increased latency and some 502s in timeline 17:30-17:40 UTC. CS is sending a short notice to high-touch customers.

Alex (oncall): small customer impact — noisy but limited. Postmortem note: temporary bypass and scale prevented broader degradation. Will keep monitoring for 30m; if stable, close PD and handoff to Joel for overnight.

Priya (eng-sre): next steps: 1) rollback the failed edge-proxy config (if root cause confirmed) 2) collect core dumps from auth-proxy pods hit by timeouts 3) gather kv eviction metrics for 24h window and correlate.

Alex (oncall): creating incident task list: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-0317-5xx (adding Priya + Joel).

pagerbot: PD update: PD-48291 auto-escalation paused.

Alex (oncall): handing off at 7305012385 to Joel (next-oncall). Joel — please own follow-ups and coordinate with kvcache team for root cause. I'll be available for questions.

Joel (next-oncall): acked. Taking over monitoring and postmortem draft. Will confirm whether edge-proxy config was causal and schedule rollback if needed.

Priya (eng-sre): saving logs and traces: `traces/inference-gateway/usw2/2026-03-17-17-30.zip` and pushed to the incident folder.

Alex (oncall): closing note before handoff: customer impact limited to short window, mitigations reduced 5xx to baseline. Will review rate-limit and timeout defaults to avoid similar cascades. :white_check_mark:
